summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a 6-K disclosing a strategic investment in Estonian-Ukrainian defence technology company DoD Solution, developer of the AURA AI onboard autonomy platform. No purchase price, stake percentage, valuation or premium was disclosed. Draganfly CEO Cameron Chell will join DoD Solution's board to accelerate integration and distribution of the technology across unmanned platforms. DoD Solution will use proceeds to bring its AURA SBC computer into production and advance AURA OS toward U.S. NDAA compliance. Deal terms and closing mechanics are undisclosed; watch for subsequent filings quantifying the investment size and ownership stake.
